## Problem and result

What does this change or establish? Link the task, issue, card or prior version.

## Evidence

Sources, input/code versions, exact commands, actual outputs and checks. Include failed checks and uncertainty. Distinguish computation from biological validation.

## Credit and disclosure

Who contributed analysis, replication, review, corrections, code or writing? Link their work. Disclose model/agent use, reused outputs and relevant involvement. Do not publish private identities or credentials.
